evidence_units.claim: PR #4530 is a two-parent merge whose second-parent ancestry is exactly the six verified commits listed in git_provenance.series_commits.
Before PR #4530, proactive pressure and ratio retention were scaled from the full context window and the pressure call site passed only contextWindow.
With W=1,048,576 and O=256,000, provider-admissible message capacity is 792,576 while the old threshold was 838,860 at ratio 0.8; the pressure gate could miss the provider rejection boundary.

The pressure path derives the effective output reservation from the latest durable request header, falling back to adapter defaultMaxTokens and then zero, and passes it explicitly to resolveCompactSpec.
The resolved budgets use M=W-O, P=M-B, T=floor(min(W*r,P)), and ratio retention floor(M*retainRatio); explicit retention remains explicit and is checked against T.
headroomTokens is a validated top-level and exact-target policy field, defaults to 65,536, and also supplies the default summarization maxTokens unless an explicit cap overrides it.
The resolver rejects invalid W and O, no-message-budget, no-pressure-budget, and retainTokens >= threshold cases with target-specific errors.
Unit tests assert numeric residual-budget values, explicit-header gating, adapter-default fallback, and degenerate reserve rejection.
Loader composition, headless e2e configuration, and real-model patches preserve the capacity/cap relationship and exact-target overrides.
The authored compaction-output-reserve replay proves proactive compaction under a bounded message budget and preserves the durable compaction event bracket and next-step continuation.
The authored compaction-summary-headroom replay proves that omitted summary maxTokens resolves to headroomTokens while explicit request output reservation remains separate.

case_workflow.title: Repair and validate shared-capacity pressure in DeepSeek Harness compaction
entry_conditions: A proactive pressure policy and a downstream request share one finite context capacity.
The request's output reservation is charged to that capacity.
The current threshold is derived from nominal capacity or the reservation is not bound at the pressure call site.
exit_conditions: Pressure threshold does not exceed the configured residual pressure budget.
Ratio retention and explicit retention satisfy the threshold relation.
Invalid residual states fail with an actionable target-specific error.
Unit, loader, deterministic replay, and applicable live-provider harness oracles pass.
exclusions: Provider-confirmed overflow recovery as a substitute for proactive pressure accounting.
Treating the summarization output cap as the routed request output reservation.
Cross-repository aggregation or Hermes-derived workflow design.

nodes.semantic_goal: Establish the shared capacity owner, durable routed target, current threshold formula, and request output reservation source.
nodes.procedure_summary: Compare parent and post-PR code; inspect the pressure call site and provider serialization; record W, O, B, and current ratio semantics.
nodes.guard: If pools are isolated or output is not charged to the same pool, reject this case workflow.
nodes.validation: The diagnosis must explain why the parent threshold can exceed provider-admissible message capacity.

nodes.semantic_goal: Bind the effective routed output reservation and capacity metadata to one policy-resolution seam.
requires: request header maxTokens or adapter defaultMaxTokens
nodes.procedure_summary: Use the durable request header cap first, otherwise adapter defaultMaxTokens, otherwise zero; obtain capacity for the current provider/model route; pass O explicitly.
nodes.guard: If no durable route exists, do not substitute AgentOptions for this pressure calculation; return the repository-defined no-target result.
nodes.validation: Explicit header cap and adapter default fallback must independently trigger the expected gating behavior; same model id across provider switches must re-resolve.

nodes.semantic_goal: Derive pressure and retention from residual message capacity, preserving the meaning of explicit versus ratio retention.
nodes.procedure_summary: Compute M=W-O; compute P=M-B; set T=floor(min(W*thresholdRatio,P)); scale ratio retention from M; retain explicit retainTokens but require it to be below T.
nodes.guard: Do not calculate from W alone; do not silently subtract B from ratio retention because this realization defines B as pressure headroom, not retained-tail capacity.
nodes.validation: For W=1,048,576, O=256,000, ratio=.8, retainRatio=.16, expect T=634,060 and retainTokens=126,812.

nodes.semantic_goal: Normalize pressure headroom and auxiliary summary output-cap defaults without conflating their roles.
nodes.procedure_summary: Validate B as non-negative; default B to 65,536; default summary maxTokens to B; preserve explicit global/per-target summary caps; propagate target override fields.
nodes.guard: If B is zero, require a positive explicit summary cap; never use summary maxTokens as O.
nodes.validation: The summary-headroom replay must record maxTokens equal to B when no explicit summary cap is configured.

nodes.semantic_goal: Validate residual-budget boundaries and preserve target-specific failure semantics.
nodes.procedure_summary: Reject invalid W/O, M<=0, P<=0, and retainTokens>=T; surface TargetPressureConfigError keyed to provider/model.
nodes.guard: A boundary error must not be replaced by silent clamping or global pressure disablement.
nodes.validation: Negative/non-integer O and exhausted message/pressure budgets must match the repository error oracles.

nodes.semantic_goal: Validate end-to-end behavior and durable continuation after proactive compaction.
nodes.procedure_summary: Run numeric unit checks, dynamic header/default fallback checks, loader composition, deterministic output-reserve and summary-headroom replays, then the guarded real-model smoke.
nodes.guard: If only deterministic replay is available, report live-provider smoke as not executed rather than treating replay as equivalent.
nodes.validation: Require threshold/retention numeric equality, compaction start-summary-end bracket, replacement checkpoint, next-step continuation, and no unintended cap drift.
